1: # GLFW
2: 
3: [![Build status](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/actions)
4: [![Build status](https://ci.appveyor.com/api/projects/status/0kf0ct9831i5l6sp/branch/master?svg=true)](https://ci.appveyor.com/project/elmindreda/glfw)
5: 
6: ## Introduction
7: 
8: GLFW is an Open Source, multi-platform library for OpenGL, OpenGL ES and Vulkan
9: application development.  It provides a simple, platform-independent API for
10: creating windows, contexts and surfaces, reading input, handling events, etc.
11: 
12: GLFW is written primarily in C99, with parts of macOS support being written in
13: Objective-C.
14: 
15: GLFW supports Windows, macOS and Linux, and also works on many other Unix-like
16: systems.  On Linux both Wayland and X11 are supported.
17: 
18: GLFW is licensed under the [zlib/libpng
19: license](https://www.glfw.org/license.html).
20: 
21: You can [download](https://www.glfw.org/download.html) the latest stable release
22: as source or Windows and macOS binaries.  There are [release
23: tags](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/releases) with source and binary archives
24: attached for every version since 3.0.
25: 
26: The [documentation](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/) is available online and is
27: also included in source and binary archives, except those generated
28: automatically by Github.  The documentation contains guides, a tutorial and the
29: API reference.  The [release
30: notes](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/news.html) list the new features,
31: caveats and deprecations in the latest release.  The [version
32: history](https://www.glfw.org/changelog.html) lists every user-visible change
33: for every release.
34: 
35: GLFW exists because of the contributions of [many people](CONTRIBUTORS.md)
36: around the world, whether by reporting bugs, providing community support, adding
37: features, reviewing or testing code, debugging, proofreading docs, suggesting
38: features or fixing bugs.
39: 
40: 
41: ## System requirements
42: 
43: GLFW supports Windows 7 and later and macOS 10.11 and later.  On GNOME Wayland,
44: window decorations will be very basic unless the
45: [libdecor](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libdecor/libdecor) package is
46: installed.  Linux and other Unix-like systems running X11 are supported even
47: without a desktop environment or modern extensions, although some features
48: require a clipboard manager or a modern window manager.
49: 
50: See the [compatibility guide](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/compat.html)
51: for more detailed information.
52: 
53: 
54: ## Compiling GLFW
55: 
56: GLFW supports compilation with Visual C++ (2013 and later), GCC and Clang.  Both
57: Clang-CL and MinGW-w64 are supported.  Other C99 compilers will likely also
58: work, but this is not regularly tested.
59: 
60: There are [pre-compiled binaries](https://www.glfw.org/download.html)
61: available for Windows and macOS.
62: 
63: GLFW itself needs only CMake and the headers and libraries for your operating
64: system and window system.  No other SDKs are required.
65: 
66: See the [compilation guide](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/compile.html) for
67: more information about compiling GLFW and the exact dependencies required for
68: each window system.
69: 
70: The examples and test programs depend on a number of tiny libraries.  These are
71: bundled in the `deps/` directory.  The repository has no submodules.
72: 
73:  - [getopt\_port](https://github.com/kimgr/getopt_port/) for examples
74:    with command-line options
75:  - [TinyCThread](https://github.com/tinycthread/tinycthread) for threaded
76:    examples
77:  - [glad2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) for loading OpenGL and Vulkan
78:    functions
79:  - [linmath.h](https://github.com/datenwolf/linmath.h) for linear algebra in
80:    examples
81:  - [Nuklear](https://github.com/Immediate-Mode-UI/Nuklear) for test and example UI
82:  - [stb\_image\_write](https://github.com/nothings/stb) for writing images to disk
83: 
84: The documentation is generated with [Doxygen](https://doxygen.org/) when the
85: library is built, provided CMake could find a sufficiently new version of it
86: during configuration.
87: 
88: 
89: ## Using GLFW
90: 
91: See the [HTML documentation](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/) for a tutorial,
92: guides and the API reference.
93: 
94: 
95: ## Contributing to GLFW
96: 
97: See the [contribution
98: guide](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for
99: more information.
100: 
101: The `master` branch is the stable integration branch and _should_ always compile
102: and run on all supported platforms.  Details of a newly added feature,
103: including the public API, may change until it has been included in a release.
104: 
105: The `latest` branch is equivalent to the [highest numbered](https://semver.org/)
106: release, although it may not always point to the same commit as the tag for that
107: release.
108: 
109: The `ci` branch is used to trigger continuous integration jobs for code under
110: testing and should never be relied on for any purpose.
111: 
112: 
113: ## Reporting bugs
114: 
115: Bugs are reported to our [issue tracker](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/issues).
116: Please check the [contribution
117: guide](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for
118: information on what to include when reporting a bug.
119: 
120: 
121: ## Changelog since 3.4
122: 
123:  - Added `GLFW_UNLIMITED_MOUSE_BUTTONS` input mode that allows mouse buttons beyond
124:    the limit of the mouse button tokens to be reported (#2423)
125:  - Added `glfwGetEGLConfig` function to query the `EGLConfig` of a window (#2045)
126:  - Added `glfwGetGLXFBConfig` function to query the `GLXFBConfig` of a window (#1925)
127:  - Updated minimum CMake version to 3.16 (#2541)
128:  - Removed support for building with original MinGW (#2540)
129:  - [Win32] Removed support for Windows XP and Vista (#2505)
130:  - [Cocoa] Added `QuartzCore` framework as link-time dependency
131:  - [Cocoa] Removed support for OS X 10.10 Yosemite and earlier (#2506)
132:  - [Cocoa] Bugfix: Cmd+Period, Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Esc key events were not emitted
133:    (#1362,#2278)
134:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: The fractional scaling related objects were not destroyed
135:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: `glfwInit` would segfault on compositor with no seat (#2517)
136:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: A drag entering a non-GLFW surface could cause a segfault
137:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Ignore key repeat events when no window has keyboard focus (#2727)
138:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Reset key repeat timer when window destroyed (#2741,#2727)
139:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Memory would leak if reading a data offer failed midway
140:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Retrieved cursor position would be incorrect when hovering over
141:                      fallback decorations
142:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Fallback decorations would report scroll events
143:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Keyboard repeat events halted when any key is released (#2568)
144:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Fallback decorations would show menu at wrong position
145:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: The cursor was not updated when clicking through from
146:    a modal to a fallback decoration
147:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: The cursor position was not updated when clicking through
148:    from a modal to the content area
149:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: free modules at end of terminate function to resolve
150:    potential segmentation fault (#2744)
151:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Confining or disabling the cursor could segfault on
152:    compositors without `pointer-constraints-unstable-v1`
153:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Key repeat did not function on very old compositors
154:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: The `libwayland-client` library was not unloaded at termination
155:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Scroll events were sent twice on some versions of GNOME (#2494)
156:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Two-dimensional scroll input was emitted as separate axes
157:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: Mouse wheel scroll distance was incorrect on some compositors
158:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: `glfwSwapBuffers` would halt with nonzero swap interval when window
159:    was suspended (#1350,#2582,#2640,#2719,#2723,#2800,#2827)
160:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: `glfwPostEmptyEvent` would leak a callback proxy (#2836)
161:  - [Wayland] Bugfix: `glfwHideWindow` did not always send its request immediately
162:  - [X11] Bugfix: Running without a WM could trigger an assert (#2593,#2601,#2631)
163:  - [X11] Bugfix: Occasional crash when an idle display awakes (#2766) 
164:  - [X11] Bugfix: Prevent BadWindow when creating small windows with a content scale
165:    less than 1 (#2754)
166:  - [X11] Bugfix: Clamp width and height to >= 1 to prevent BadValue error and app exit
167:  - [X11] Bugfix: Floating windows silently became non-floating when hidden (#2276)
168:  - [X11] Bugfix: The `libXext` library was not unloaded at termination
169:  - [Linux] Bugfix: The header for `ioctl` was only implicitly included (#2778)
170:  - [Null] Added Vulkan 'window' surface creation via `VK_EXT_headless_surface`
171:  - [Null] Added EGL context creation on Mesa via `EGL_MESA_platform_surfaceless`
172:  - [EGL] Allowed native access on Wayland with `GLFW_CONTEXT_CREATION_API` set to
173:    `GLFW_NATIVE_CONTEXT_API` (#2518)
174: 
175: 
176: ## Contact
177: 
178: On [glfw.org](https://www.glfw.org/) you can find the latest version of GLFW, as
179: well as news, documentation and other information about the project.
180: 
181: If you have questions related to the use of GLFW, we have a
182: [forum](https://discourse.glfw.org/).
183: 
184: If you have a bug to report, a patch to submit or a feature you'd like to
185: request, please file it in the
186: [issue tracker](https://github.com/glfw/glfw/issues) on GitHub.
187: 
188: Finally, if you're interested in helping out with the development of GLFW or
189: porting it to your favorite platform, join us on the forum or GitHub.

def count(patterns, file_filter=None):
    total={p:0 for p in patterns}
    locs={p:[] for p in patterns}
    for f in files:
        if file_filter and not file_filter(f):
            continue
        try:
            text=open(f).read()
        except: continue
        for p in patterns:
            # regex word boundary for identifiers
            rx=re.compile(r'\b'+re.escape(p)+r'\b')
            matches=list(rx.finditer(text))
            total[p]+=len(matches)
            for m in matches[:3]:
                line=text[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
                rel=os.path.relpath(f,src)
                locs[p].append(f"{rel}:{line}")
    return total,locs

1: ---
2: name: function-summary
3: description: Summarize and classify what a third-party library or application does, by reading its source — README/docs, public API surface, module layout, and key implementation files. Produces a prose summary plus capability categories with evidence. Use for dimension 1 of PC library/application analysis. This is model reasoning, not a script.
4: ---
5: 
6: # Function summary & classification (model-driven)
7: 
8: Decide what the subject *is for* and break its capabilities into categories. This
9: is judgment work — read the source, don't pattern-match keywords.
10: 
11: **先判 `library.kind`（被分析对象是库还是应用）。** 这关系到后续维度（尤其 dim-9 鸿蒙口径）：
12: - `library`：被别的代码以 **API 调用**、经包管理器分发（有 public API / 导出符号 / 包名）。
13: - `application`：被**终端用户启动运行**——有启动器/入口、打包分发、GUI 或 CLI 界面（如 VisualVM
14:   这类桌面工具）。其它：`framework`/`tool`/`cli`/`service`/`plugin`/`other`。信号：有 `main`/
15:   启动器脚本/原生 launcher/打包目标(installer/zip)/品牌化/GUI 工具包 ⇒ 多半是 application。
16: 把判断写进 `library.kind`。**对 application，summary 与 categories 按「终端用户能用它做什么、
17: 有哪些功能模块」描述，而不是当作被调用的 API**（应用通常没有稳定对外 API）。
18: 
19: ## 主旨与原则
20: **输出契约（下方 Output）是唯一硬约束。** 下面的清单与取值是**推荐起点，不是封闭清单** ——
21: 遇到不匹配的场景，尽力归类，必要时**自造一个简洁的小写值**，并写进 `meta.observations`。
22: 方法仅是参考思路，可按仓库实际调整；把推理空间留给自己，只要产出符合契约即可。
23: 
24: ## Evidence to gather (in priority order)
25: 1. **Manifest / package metadata** — the strongest signal for the library's
26:    ecosystem. Look for:
27:    - `pyproject.toml`, `setup.py`, `setup.cfg` → Python
28:    - `pom.xml`, `build.gradle*` → Java
29:    - `package.json` → Node.js
30:    - `Cargo.toml` → Rust
31:    - `go.mod` → Go
32:    - `*.csproj`, `*.fsproj` → .NET
33: 2. **README / docs** — `README*`, `docs/`, project website links, the package
34:    description in `package.json` / `pyproject.toml` / `pom.xml`. This is the
35:    authors' own framing; weight it heavily but verify against code.
36: 3. **Public API surface** — exported symbols: Python `__all__` and top-level
37:    `def`/`class` in package `__init__.py`; C/C++ public headers (`include/`);
38:    Java public classes; JS package `main`/`exports`. The public API reveals the
39:    intended capabilities better than internal files. When codegraph is available
40:    (the agent will tell you), use `codegraph context "<area>" -p repos/<name>` and
41:    `codegraph files -p repos/<name>` to map the symbol/module surface fast; fall
42:    back to grep/Read when it isn't.
43: 4. **Module / directory layout** — top-level dirs often map to feature areas.
44:    借 `metrics.json` 的 `code_metrics.top_dirs` 看结构。
45: 5. **A few key implementation files** — open the largest or most central
46:    production files to confirm what the API actually does.
47: 
48: **描述库本体（生产代码），不要把测试/示例当成库的能力。** 当一个仓库其实是**示例/教程
49: 集合**（无可安装包；顶层目录基本都是按功能命名、各自独立可运行的 demo——如 PyQt 的
50: `QLabel/`/`QThread/`/`QAxWidget/`，外加 `Demo/`/`Test/`），如实说明它是「示例/教程集合，
51: 非可发布生产库」，能力分类围绕「它演示了什么」而非把每个 demo 的平台用法当作库的特性。
52: 
53: ## Determine the ecosystem
54: Before classifying capabilities, decide which ecosystem the library belongs to.
55: Use the manifest signal first; if ambiguous, fall back to the primary language
56: from the code-metrics output. Allowed values are exactly:
57: 
58: | Value    | Meaning |
59: |----------|---------|
60: | `python` | Python package (pip / poetry / setuptools) |
61: | `java`   | Java library / JAR (Maven / Gradle) |
62: | `nodejs` | Node.js / JavaScript package (npm / yarn / pnpm) |
63: | `cpp`    | C or C++ library |
64: | `rust`   | Rust crate |
65: | `go`     | Go module |
66: | `dotnet` | .NET library (C# / F#) |
67: | `other`  | Unclear or none of the above |
68: 
69: Rules:
70: - If multiple manifests exist, prefer the one that declares the primary package.
71: - If the repo is a polyglot binding wrapper (e.g. a Python package wrapping a C
72:   extension), classify by the package's distribution language/ecosystem.
73: - If no manifest is present and the primary language is mixed or unclear, use
74:   `other`.
75: 
76: ## How to classify
77: - Group capabilities into **3–7 categories**, each a coherent feature area
78:   (e.g. "HTTP client", "Connection pooling", "TLS/SSL", "Async I/O").
79: - Each category needs concrete **evidence**: the file(s), module(s) or symbol(s)
80:   that implement it. No evidence → don't claim it.
81: - Identify the **domain** (networking / graphics / ML / crypto / data / GUI / …)
82:   and the **target users** (app developers? other libraries? CLI users?).
83: 
84: ## Output (fills report `function_summary`)
85: ```json
86: {
87:   "summary": "2-4 sentences: what it does and for whom.",
88:   "categories": [
89:     {"name": "...", "description": "...", "evidence": ["src/http/client.py", "Session"]}
90:   ],
91:   "domain": "networking",
92:   "target_users": "Python application developers",
93:   "ecosystem": "python"
94: }
95: ```
96: Also set `library.one_liner` (<=120 chars), `library.ecosystem` (the **core**
97: ecosystem, one of the allowed values above), and `library.package_name` — the
98: **distribution/package name** declared in the manifest (`[project].name` / `name`
99: in `package.json` / Maven `artifactId` / `Cargo.toml` `name`), which may differ
100: from the repo dir name. Set it to `null` if there is no manifest or it is uncertain.
101: 
102: Set `library.bindings` — the languages the library exposes **bindings/wrappers**
103: for beyond its core ecosystem (so a polyglot library isn't shown as single-language).
104: E.g. a C++ core with Boost.Python + SWIG Java/C# bindings → `["python","java","dotnet"]`;
105: a JS package with a WASM/native core → list accordingly. Look for binding dirs/tools
106: (`*.pyx`/`pybind11`/Boost.Python, `*.i` SWIG, JNI `*Wrappers`, N-API, emscripten/CFFI).
107: Use `[]` if it only targets its core ecosystem.
108: 
109: ## Language
110: - Write `summary`, every category `name`/`description`, `domain`, `target_users`,
111:   and `library.one_liner` in **简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)**. Keep proper nouns
112:   (library/API/dependency names, language names) in their original form.
113: 
114: ## Rules
115: - Ground every claim in something you actually read. Never invent features.
116: - If docs and code disagree, trust the code and note it.
117: - If the library is large, sample breadth over depth — cover all top-level areas
118:   rather than fully reading one.
119: 
120: ## 自我发现（反哺）
121: 若发现「推荐取值覆盖不到的新场景(new_value) / 契约或分类的盲区(gap) / 难归类的歧义(ambiguity)」，
122: 追加到顶层 `meta.observations`：`{dimension:"function_summary", field, kind, value, rationale}`，
123: 供面板「模型观察」页人工反哺 skill。

(End of file - total 123 lines)

1: ---
2: name: harmony-adaptation
3: description: Assess the feasibility, difficulty, and porting path of adapting a third-party library or application to HarmonyOS NEXT PC (self-developed kernel, ArkTS app layer, OHOS NDK native layer, Node-API bridge — no Linux ABI). A SYNTHESIS step over the already-computed native_api / runtime_surface / dependencies / build_env / library blocks. Use for dimension 9 of PC library/application analysis. Model reasoning, prescriptive (gives an adaptation plan).
4: ---
5: 
6: # HarmonyOS PC adaptation assessment (model-driven, synthesis)
7: 
8: The final, **prescriptive** dimension. Earlier dimensions describe *what the library
9: is and what it touches*; this one answers **"how hard is it to port to 鸿蒙 PC, and
10: which path do we take"** and produces a concrete adaptation plan with difficulty,
11: path, blockers, and effort.
12: 
13: This is a **synthesis** step: you do NOT re-scan the source. You reason over the
14: already-filled blocks — `library.ecosystem`/`bindings`, `native_api` (groups +
15: `category`/`platform`, **以及 `native_api.dynamic_libraries`** —— 运行时经
16: ctypes/dlopen/LoadLibrary/JNA 动态加载的库), `runtime_surface`
17: (subprocess/filesystem/network/env/devices), `dependencies`, `build_env` —— and
18: **reuse their `evidence`** (the same `file:line`).
19: 
20: ## 主旨与原则
21: **输出契约（下方 Output）是唯一硬约束。** 闭轴取值固定、UI 依赖它们；开放词可自创。
22: 与 dim 8 相反——本维度**给适配建议**（这就是交付物），且是**前序维度的综合产物**，不重扫源码。
23: 遇到清单外的阻碍类型或路径，尽力归类、自创一个简洁小写值，并在 `meta.observations` 记录。
24: 
25: ### 目标平台：HarmonyOS PC（两种部署模型，库默认走「运行时模型」）
26: 鸿蒙 PC 自研内核（**非 Linux ABI**，不能直接跑 Linux ELF / 用 Linux 系统调用）；
27: 原生层 **OHOS NDK**（musl libc + **POSIX 子集**，clang/CMake `ohos.toolchain.cmake`，
28: 产物 `.so`）；架构 arm64 / x86_64。**关键事实：鸿蒙 PC 已移植主流语言运行时**——一个
29: PC 第三方**库**的自然部署方式是「跑在已移植的运行时上」，运行时本身**不是阻碍**，
30: 真正的移植工作只在它的**原生扩展 / C 依赖 / 平台特有 API**。
31: 
32: **目标平台能力是单一事实源：`references/harmony-pc-capabilities.json`**（机器权威源；`.md` 是它的
33: 渲染视图）。评估前必读——它维护鸿蒙 PC 的语言运行时、JDK 内部模块开放性、桌面 GUI/窗口栈、桌面集成、
34: 进程/安全模型、应用交付模型、架构等能力及其状态（available/partial/unavailable/**unknown**）。
35: **该画像对库与应用通用**（目标事实与被分析对象无关：一个 Qt **库**与一个 Qt **应用**同样受「Qt 是否
36: 已鸿蒙化」这条事实约束）。基调：**主流语言运行时已移植**（Node/Python/Java/Rust/Go/Julia），所以一个
37: **库**的运行时本身不是阻碍；但**应用**能否跑还取决于 GUI/进程/交付等目标能力。**先看「该语言是否有
38: 已移植运行时」，有就别假设没有、别据此判 `infeasible`。**
39: 
40: **准确性 = match(源所需能力, 目标能力)。结论必须建立在参考里的目标事实上，未核实(unknown)的不要臆测**
41: （见下「目标匹配」步）。
42: 
43: **两种部署模型（评估口径）：**
44: - **模型 A（默认，命令行 / 桌面库）**：库跑在上表的已移植运行时上。运行时**不是阻碍**；
45:   阻碍点 = 原生扩展（C/C++ via cffi/ctypes/C-API/N-API/JNI）需经 OHOS NDK 重编、C / 系统
46:   依赖的可移植性、平台特有系统调用 / 外部命令 / `/proc`·`/sys` / 注册表等。库分析**默认
47:   按此口径**。
48: - **模型 B（次要，ArkTS 沙箱 GUI 应用）**：应用层 **ArkTS/ArkUI**（运行在 ArkCompiler，
49:   **不是 Node.js**），ArkTS↔C/C++ 经 **Node-API（napi）** 桥接，应用沙箱化、硬件/系统访问
50:   受权限(ACL)管控；此口径下 Node 核心模块不可用、需 `@ohos.*` 平替。**仅当目标确为 ArkTS
51:   应用时才用此口径**，并在 `notes` 注明结论是按模型 B 收紧的。
52: - **模型 C（整包桌面应用，当 `library.kind == application`）**：被分析对象是**终端用户启动运行
53:   的应用**（如 VisualVM 这类桌面工具），移植问题 = 「能否在鸿蒙 PC 上**打包并启动运行**」。
54:   运行时（JRE/Node 等）已移植可复用、不是阻碍；按这些维度判阻碍：
55:   - **GUI 工具包在 OHOS 是否可用**：Swing/AWT 取决于鸿蒙 JDK 的 AWT/桌面支持；JavaFX/SWT/Qt/
56:     GTK/Electron 各自判（无对应即重度阻碍）；RCP 平台（NetBeans `org.openide`/Eclipse）要整套
57:     窗口/模块系统都能跑。
58:   - **窗口系统 / 桌面集成**：多窗口/docking、系统托盘、文件对话框、拖拽、剪贴板、全局快捷键 ——
59:     鸿蒙桌面有无对应能力。
60:   - **启动器与打包**：原生 launcher（`*.exe`/C++ 启动器）需重编；分发格式 → 鸿蒙应用包。
61:   - **运行期服务**（`runtime_surface.services`）：进程 attach、jvmstat/jstatd、JMX、JNI 原生
62:     agent —— 若依赖各平台预编译二进制且**无 OHOS 版**（如 VisualVM 的 `libprofilerinterface`），
63:     列入 `unadaptable_apis`/`blockers`。
64:   应用走模型 C，**不要**套用「重编 + Node-API 暴露给 ArkTS」的库口径（那是把库链接进别的代码）。
65: 
66: **无论哪种模型，下列仍是真实阻碍点：**
67: - **外部命令 shell-out**：`dmidecode`/`lspci`/`wmic`/`powershell`/`ioreg`/`smartctl`
68:   等 —— 沙箱/受限环境不允许或这些工具鸿蒙上不存在 → 多为 `blocker`。
69: - **内核伪文件 / 平台接口**：`/proc`·`/sys`、Windows 注册表/WMI、Win32 API、macOS
70:   Cocoa/IOKit —— 无对应或需经 `@ohos.*` 系统能力替代。
71: - **POSIX 子集缺口**：`fork`、System V IPC、`epoll`/`inotify`、部分 `ioctl`/信号 ——
72:   musl/OHOS 可能缺失或受限,逐项判 `partial`。
73: - **Node 核心模块（仅模型 B 下）**：`child_process`、ArkTS 版缺失的 `fs`/`os`/`net`/
74:   `http`/`process` —— 跑在鸿蒙 Node.js 上时（模型 A）这些基本可用，无需改写。

76: ## How to assess
77: 0. **先按 `library.kind` 选模型**：`application` → **模型 C（整包桌面应用）**，据
78:    GUI 工具包 / 窗口·桌面集成 / 启动器·打包 / 运行期服务（见上）判阻碍与分级；其它（库）→
79:    模型 A（默认）/ 仅当目标是 ArkTS 应用才 B。下面的「由 ecosystem 定基调」对两类都适用
80:    （决定运行时是否已移植），但**应用的阻碍重心在 GUI/打包/服务，而非「被链接进别的代码」**。
81: 0b. **目标匹配（关键，决定准确性）—— 读 `references/harmony-pc-capabilities.json`，把本项目「所需的
82:    目标能力」逐项对照目标状态**，并把每一项写进 `target_assumptions[]`（`{capability, required,
83:    target_status, impact, source}`）：
84:    - 需列出的「所需能力」：（应用尤其）所用 **GUI 工具包**(Swing/AWT/JavaFX/Qt…) 与窗口/桌面集成项、
85:      所需 **JDK 内部模块**(jdk.attach/jvmstat/JVMTI…)、**进程/attach 模型**、**应用交付形态**；
86:      （库）通常只有「该语言运行时已移植」一条。
87:    - 给每条假设一个稳定 `id`（如 `ta:swing`），供下游 `blockers`/`unadaptable_apis` 的 `caused_by` 回指。
88:    - 据 `target_status` **显式驱动**下游（同一事实只登记一次、其余引用，不重复计入难度）：
89:      `available`→不计阻碍；`partial`→**必产**一条 `blocker`（`adaptability: partial`）`caused_by` 指回该假设 id；
90:      `unavailable`→**必产**一条 `blocker`（`adaptability: unadaptable`），若为具体 API 再进 `unadaptable_apis`
91:      并让 blocker 的 `manifests_as` 指向它；**`unknown`→`target_assumptions` 记一条且若 `required` 则
92:      **把本维度 `confidence` 下调至多 `medium`**、在 `notes` 注明「结论依赖未核实的目标事实：…」——禁止据
93:      unknown 臆断为 `feasible`/`no_adaptation`**。
94:    - 一项 `required:true` 且 `unavailable` ⇒ 该形态多半 `infeasible` 或需换形态（在 summary 说清）。
95: 1. **由 `library.ecosystem` 定基调与默认路径**（默认走模型 A：跑在已移植运行时上）：
96:    - `python` → 默认 `run_on_ported_runtime`：跑在鸿蒙 Python 3.12 上。**纯 Python 无原生
97:      扩展 → `feasible`/`low`/`S`**；含 C 扩展（cffi/ctypes/C-API，如 cairocffi/pypdfium2）
98:      → 扩展需经 OHOS NDK 重编 = 真正工作量，难度由该原生依赖的可移植性决定（medium/high）。
99:    - `nodejs`/JS-TS → 默认 `run_on_ported_runtime`：跑在鸿蒙 Node.js 24 上，Node 核心模块
100:      基本可用。含 N-API 原生插件 → 插件需 OHOS NDK 重编。**仅当目标是 ArkTS 沙箱应用时**
101:      才走 `arkts_rewrite`（此时 Node 核心模块不可用、需 `@ohos.*` 重写，并在 notes 注明）。
102:    - `java` → 默认 `run_on_ported_runtime`：跑在鸿蒙 JDK 17 上。含 JNI 原生库 → 原生库需
103:      OHOS NDK 重编。
104:    - `rust`/`go` → `cross_compile`：Rust 有 ohos target(较顺),Go 支持较好 → 难度低/中。
105:    - `cpp`/`c` → 默认 `recompile_napi`：经 OHOS NDK 重编 + Node-API 暴露给 ArkTS；难度
106:      由 POSIX 子集缺口 + `native_api` 里的 `platform`/`system`/`hardware` 组数量决定。
107:    - **运行时已移植 ⇒ 别再据「无运行时」判 `infeasible`/`abandon`**；`infeasible` 仅留给
108:      运行时未移植 **且** 重度平台耦合且无替代的真正无解情形。
109: 2. **逐组消费前序维度,生成 `blockers`**（每条带来源维度的 `evidence`）：
110:    - `native_api`：每个 `category` 为 `platform`/`system`/`hardware` 的组 → 候选阻碍；
111:      `standard`/`portable`（STL、musl 支持的 POSIX、ArkTS 有对应的）通常不算或 `minor`。
112:    - `native_api.dynamic_libraries`（ctypes/dlopen/LoadLibrary/JNA 运行时加载的库）→
113:      **逐个**判其**自身**在鸿蒙 PC 上是否存在/可移植（看 `acquisition`/`source`：`system`
114:      平台库 vs `self_build` 包装器）：
115:      · 平台专有 GUI/图形/系统库（X11/XCB、Win32 `user32`/`gdi32`、macOS CoreGraphics 等）→
116:        鸿蒙无等价 → `blocker`，`harmony_status: replace_with_ohos`（改用 @ohos 图形/显示能力）
117:        或 `unavailable`（须重写该功能）；
118:      · 跨平台且已移植到 OHOS 的通用库 → `minor`/`partial`，重编/重定位即可。
119:      每条复用该库的加载点 `evidence`(file:line)，`source_dimension: native_api`。
120:    - `runtime_surface.subprocess` → 调用具体平台命令(dmidecode/wmic/ioreg…)通常 `blocker`；
121:      仅为通用 shell-out 且鸿蒙有等价工具的 `minor`/`partial`（模型 B 沙箱下统一更严，多 `blocker`）。
122:    - `runtime_surface.filesystem/devices` 里的 `/proc`·`/sys`·`/dev`、注册表路径 → 阻碍。
123:    - `dependencies`：每个 `native`/`remote`/`system` 依赖须自身可移植；不可移植 → 阻碍。
124:      **但先看是否已鸿蒙化**：依赖若带 `harmony_adapted: true`（已在 OpenHarmony PC 官方源提供
125:      移植产物——**Python** 包在 pypi.cnb.cool/OpenHarmonyPCDeveloper 有 `*-ohos_*.whl`，如
126:      numpy/scipy/pandas；**C/C++** 库在 cmd-pkgs 预编译清单里，如 zlib/openssl/boost/eigen/
127:      cairo/freetype）→ **不计阻碍**，直接用鸿蒙版；这类依赖越多，难度/工作量越低。仅对**未**
128:      鸿蒙化且不可移植的依赖才记 `blocker`/`major`。
129:    - `build_env`：工具链(CMake/musl 兼容性)、`compiler_extensions`(MSVC/GCC 特有)、
130:      是否覆盖 arm64/x86_64 → 阻碍或注意点。
131: 3. **判每条阻碍的 `harmony_status` 与 `remediation`**：能用 `@ohos.*` 平替的写
132:    `replace_with_ohos` + 具体 API；需权限的 `needs_permission`;部分支持 `partial`;
133:    彻底没有 `unavailable`。
134: 4. **汇总：估 `effort.person_days` 区间 + 判 `feasibility`**（难度 `effort.level` 由 server 派生，**你无需自填**）。
135:    你只输出两个**可观测**的量：`porting_class`（见第 5 步，权威机器轴）与 `effort.person_days:[min,max]`
136:    人-天区间（区间宽度表达不确定性）。`feasibility` 与 porting_class 确定性对应（no_adaptation→feasible；
137:    recompile_only/needs_adaptation_full→feasible_with_effort；needs_adaptation_partial→hard；infeasible→infeasible），
138:    照填即可。**person_days 估算锚点（同 server 派 level 的 rubric）**：
139: 
140:    | 量级 | person_days | 典型 porting_class | 特征 |
141:    |---|---|---|---|
142:    | 极低 | 0–2 | no_adaptation | 纯脚本跑已移植运行时，零原生/平台耦合，至多打包 |
143:    | 低 | 2–5 | recompile_only | 仅 OHOS NDK 重编/交叉编译，无平台 API 改动 |
144:    | 中 | 5–15 | needs_adaptation_full（量小） | 用到功能全可适配，阻碍点少且都有 @ohos 替代/重编路径 |
145:    | 高 | 15–40 | partial 或 full（量大） | 有少量 unadaptable_apis 但核心可用，或阻碍点多/含 GUI·桌面集成大改 |
146:    | 极高 | 40+ | infeasible（或近） | 核心依赖无解平台·硬件 API，或需 arkts_rewrite 整体重写 |
147: 
148:    **不要因为是 Python/Java/JS 就判 `infeasible`——运行时已移植。** 对 FFI/ctypes 型库，
149:    **动态加载的平台库是否有鸿蒙等价才是定 person_days/feasibility 的主因**（运行时已移植不再是主阻碍）。
150:    **参考 `code_metrics.platform_adaptation`（各平台编译宏包裹的代码量）作为复杂度信号**：windows/macos/linux/posix
151:    守卫代码越多 → 鸿蒙需新增/适配的平台分支越多 → `person_days` 上调、更可能产 toolchain/posix_subset_gap 类
152:    `blocker`（C/C++ 库尤甚）；该数为空或很小 → 平台耦合轻。其它语言的平台分支（Python `sys.platform`/Java
153:    `os.name`/Rust `cfg!(target_os)`）无此机械计数，按 native_api/源码定性判断。
154: 5. **定 `porting_class`（闭轴，依赖拓扑图用）** —— 把本库归入 5 类之一，与上面自洽：
155:    - `no_adaptation`：纯脚本（Python/Java/JS…）跑在已移植运行时上，无原生扩展、无平台耦合
156:      （≈ `feasible`/`run_on_ported_runtime`/无 blocker）。
157:    - `recompile_only`：C/C++ 等只需经 OHOS NDK **重新编译**即可，不依赖平台/底层 API、无平台差异
158:      （≈ `recompile_napi`/`cross_compile`，阻碍仅 native_dependency/posix 子集/toolchain 等 ≤major）。
159:    - `needs_adaptation_full`（**全部可适配**）：需改造，但**用到的功能全部能在鸿蒙适配/有替代**，
160:      无因平台/硬件 API 而彻底无法适配的功能（≈ 有平台类 `blocker`/`major` 但都给得出 `remediation`；
161:      `unadaptable_apis` 为空）。
162:    - `needs_adaptation_partial`（**部分可适配**）：**部分功能因平台/硬件 API 无对应实现而无法适配**
163:      （这些必须逐个列入 `unadaptable_apis`），但核心仍可用（≈ `feasible_with_effort`/`hard`，
164:      `unadaptable_apis` 非空）。
165:    - `infeasible`：核心不可适配 / 依赖特定硬件 / 无解（≈ `feasibility: infeasible`）。
166:    - （旧值 `needs_adaptation` 仍兼容，等同 partial 档；新输出请用 full/partial 二选一。）
167:    - **应用（模型 C）下重新诠释**：`no_adaptation`=纯运行时应用且 GUI 工具包鸿蒙已具备、直接跑；
168:      `recompile_only`=仅原生启动器/JNI agent 需重编；`needs_adaptation_full`=GUI/窗口/桌面集成需改
169:      但都能适配；`needs_adaptation_partial`=部分功能（如依赖无 OHOS 版的预编译 agent、特定桌面能力）
170:      无法适配并列入 `unadaptable_apis`；`infeasible`=核心依赖鸿蒙缺失的桌面环境/硬件且无替代。
171: 5b. **填 `unadaptable_apis`（API 粒度，父库综合用）** —— 仅当本库存在**确实无法在鸿蒙适配**的底层
172:    API 时列出；这是自底向上综合的关键：服务端会把**父库的 `dependencies[].used_symbols` 与子库此清单的
173:    `public_entry` 求交**，命中才把该子计为父的阻碍——所以 `public_entry` 要尽量填准，父库不调用到就不阻塞父的迁移。
174:    每项 `{id, api, public_entry, reason, blocking_native_api, category(platform/system/hardware/ffi), evidence, caused_by?}`，
175:    `id` 形如 `ua:culaunch`，证据复用 `native_api` 的调用点。纯脚本 / 仅需重编 / 全部可适配 的库此项为空。
176:    - **`public_entry` 命名约定（决定 rollup 能否命中，务必遵守）**：填**父库实际 import/调用本库时引用的那个名字**，
177:      与依赖维度的 `dependencies[].used_symbols` **同一约定**——Python 用 `module.func` / `Class.method`；
178:      JS/TS 用导出名（`pkg.export` 或具名导出）；C/C++ 用自由函数名或 `Class::method`；Java 用 `Class.method` 或 `pkg.Class`。
179:      避免填内部静态函数名（父库引用不到 → rollup 漏判）。
180:    - **自底向上填写顺序（先粒度、后引用，避免同一事实写三遍）**：① 先填 `unadaptable_apis`（最细粒度）；
181:      ② 再写 `blockers`，把对应项的 `manifests_as` 指向 `ua:*`、`caused_by` 指向根因 `ta:*`；③ `target_assumptions` 作根因层。
182:      一个事实只在其主清单写完整内容，其余清单只用 id 引用。
183: 6. **`compatible` 与 `key_tasks`**：列可顺利移植的部分(纯算法/数据结构/标准库逻辑)、
184:    落地推荐路径的关键工作项。

191:   "porting_class": "recompile_only",
192:   "feasibility": "feasible_with_effort",
193:   "effort": {"person_days": [3, 6]},
194:   "confidence": "high",

234:   `unadaptable_apis: [{"id":"ua:culaunch","api":"cuLaunchKernel","public_entry":"foo.gpu_render","reason":"鸿蒙无 CUDA 运行时，无替代","blocking_native_api":"cuLaunchKernel","category":"hardware","evidence":["src/gpu.c:120"],"caused_by":["ta:cuda"]}]`，

236: - **目标确为 ArkTS 沙箱应用的 JS 库**：才用 `arkts_rewrite`，Node 核心模块 → `@ohos.*`，
237:   并在 `notes` 注明是按模型 B 评估。
238: 
239: ## Rules
240: - **只综合,不重扫源码** —— 结论与 `evidence` 都来自前序维度;每条 `blocker` 标
241:   `source_dimension` 并复用其 `file:line`。
242: - **生产范围** —— 因 dims 6/7/8 已限定生产代码（排除测试/示例/演示），`blockers` 与
243:   `unadaptable_apis` 自然也是：**只在测试/示例里用到的平台 API 不是迁移阻碍**，不要列入。
244:   若整仓是**示例/教程集合**（生产代码≈0），据库本体收敛——`porting_class` 不按 demo 定档，
245:   `unadaptable_apis` 近空，`notes` 注明「本仓为示例集合，平台 API 仅见于示例」。
246: - 闭轴(`feasibility`/`porting_class`/`confidence`/`blockers[].severity`/`blockers[].adaptability`/`effort.level`)
247:   取值**必须**落在 schema enum 内;开放词(`recommended_path`/`category`/`harmony_status`)按实际写。
248:   **`effort.level` 由 server 派生，你不必填**；你填 `porting_class` + `effort.person_days` + `feasibility`。
249:   `porting_class` 必须与 `feasibility`/路径自洽（见 How-to 第 4/5 步映射），并与 `unadaptable_apis`
250:   自洽：`unadaptable_apis` 非空 ⇒ `porting_class: needs_adaptation_partial`（或 `infeasible`）；
251:   为空且仍需改造 ⇒ `needs_adaptation_full`。
252: - 引用完整性 + 去重：每个 `caused_by`/`manifests_as` 引用的 id 必须在对应清单存在；同一事实只在主清单
253:   写完整内容、其余引用，避免重复计入难度。任一 `blocker.adaptability: unadaptable` 应同时在 `unadaptable_apis`
254:   有对应项（除非不是具体 API）。
255: - 闭轴之间须自洽:大量 `blocker` / 长 `person_days` 不能配 `feasibility: feasible`；反之
256:   **纯脚本库（运行时已移植 + 无原生扩展 + 无平台耦合）不能配 `infeasible`**——应是
257:   `feasible`/`person_days:[0,2]`。required+unknown 假设存在时 `confidence` 至多 `medium`。
258: - **默认按模型 A（库跑在鸿蒙已移植运行时上）评估**；只有目标明确是 ArkTS 沙箱应用才用
259:   模型 B，并在 `notes` 注明。已移植运行时（Python/Node/Java/Rust/Go/Julia）本身不计为阻碍。
260: - 描述要可执行:`remediation` 给具体的 `@ohos.*` 平替或裁剪决定,不空泛。
261: - 评估基于代码证据,不臆造鸿蒙能力;不确定写进 `notes`。

The final, **prescriptive** dimension. Earlier dimensions describe *what the library
is and what it touches*; this one answers **"how hard is it to port to 鸿蒙 PC, and
which path do we take"** and produces a concrete adaptation plan with difficulty,

1: ---
2: name: native-api-analysis
3: description: Analyze a third-party library's or application's use of low-level and platform APIs — Win32, POSIX, C/C++ standard library, OS syscalls, GPU/graphics APIs, and FFI bridges (ctypes, JNI, N-API) — by reading source includes and call sites, and judging platform dependence. Use for dimension 7 of PC library/application analysis. Model reasoning over code, not a fixed grep list.
4: ---
5: 
6: # System & platform API analysis (model-driven)
7: 
8: Determine which system, platform and standard-library APIs the library calls
9: into, and classify each. Use search to locate candidates, then **read the call
10: sites** to confirm — a fixed symbol grep produces false positives and misses
11: indirection. This is descriptive (what it calls), not advice.
12: 
13: ## 主旨与原则
14: 目标：一张「这个库到底碰了哪些平台/系统 API、在哪碰的」的可下钻清单。
15: **输出契约（下方 Output）是唯一硬约束。** `category`/`platform` 是**稳定闭轴**（按可移植性，下面给定）；
16: `type`（API 家族名）与各 API 名是**开放词**，按实际写。遇到分类清单覆盖不到的情况，尽力归类，
17: 必要时在 `meta.observations` 记录。方法是参考思路，可按仓库调整。
18: 
19: ## Classify every group by PORTABILITY (`category`) + `platform`
20: Use a **consistent portability lens** — Win32 and POSIX-only calls are the SAME kind
21: of thing (OS-specific), so they share the `platform` category, distinguished only by
22: the `platform` field:
23: - **standard** — language standard library / runtime, available everywhere: C++ STL,
24:   Python stdlib (`os`/`io`/`logging`…), Java SE (`java.io`/`java.net`/`java.nio`),
25:   Node core (`fs`/`net`/`stream`). → `platform: portable`.
26: - **platform** — OS-specific, gone if you switch OS: **Win32** (`platform: windows`),
27:   **POSIX-only** (`mmap`/`fork`/`pthread`/`epoll`, `<unistd.h>`/`<fcntl.h>`/`<sys/mman.h>`
28:   → `platform: posix`), macOS Cocoa/Carbon (`macos`), Linux-only `inotify`/`netlink`
29:   (`linux`), glibc/MSVC extensions.
30: - **system** — kernel / system-call level ONLY: raw `syscall()`, `ioctl`, `/proc`·`/sys`,
31:   Windows registry/WMI, device handles. (Do NOT put ordinary POSIX file/mem APIs here —
32:   those are `platform`+`posix`.)
33: - **ffi** — interop bridges: ctypes/cffi, JNI, N-API.
34: - **hardware** — GPU / SIMD / accelerators: OpenGL/Vulkan/DirectX/Metal/CUDA/OpenCL,
35:   x86/ARM SIMD intrinsics. → `platform` usually the OS or `portable`.
36: 
37: > **应用（application）尤需关注**：桌面 GUI 工具包（Swing/AWT、JavaFX、SWT、Qt、GTK、Electron）
38: > 与 RCP 平台（NetBeans `org.openide`/`org.netbeans`、Eclipse）是应用的平台相关面，按 `platform`
39: > 归类；JDK 内部/`sun.*`/Attach API（`com.sun.tools.attach`）、JNI 原生 agent 同样要列入——它们
40: > 是 dim-9 判断应用能否在鸿蒙跑起来的关键。
41: 
42: ## Drill down to individual APIs (`apis`)
43: For each group, fill `apis` with the **specific APIs actually called** — representative,
44: not every call site. Each entry: `name`, a one-line 简体中文 `purpose`, `count`
45: (how many call sites / occurrences — approximate via `grep -c` or codegraph callers),
46: `evidence` (`file:line`, 1-3 representative sites), and `conditional` (true if guarded
47: by `#ifdef`/platform branch). This turns the dimension into a concrete, drill-down
48: inventory of which API is called, how often, and where.
49: 
50: > **喂给 dim-9（鸿蒙适配）**：这里标为 `platform`/`system`/`hardware` 且鸿蒙无对应实现的具体
51: > API，正是 dim-9 `harmony_adaptation.unadaptable_apis[]` 的来源（按 API 名 + 调用点证据）。本维度
52: > 只做"是什么 API、在哪、可移植性如何"的客观清点，是否"无法适配"由 dim-9 综合判定——但务必把
53: > 这些 API 的 `name`/`evidence` 列准，dim-9 与父库 `used_symbols` 求交都依赖它。
54: 
55: **One entry = one concrete API.** Do NOT bundle several calls into one `name`
56: (`mmap / munmap`, `open / fstat / close`, `std::async / std::future`,
57: `PyObject / Py_INCREF`). List tightly-related variants as **separate entries** so each
58: carries its own `count` and `evidence` — bundling defeats the per-API count. `count`
59: is **required** for every entry.
60: 
61: **Pseudo-file / pseudo-interface APIs** (procfs/sysfs, Windows registry, WMI-style
62: queries, device handles): these ARE system APIs — a `/proc/cpuinfo` read is a kernel
63: query, the Linux equivalent of a syscall — so keep them in `category: system`. But
64: don't list a **bare path** as the `name`; write it as **`family (specific node)`** so it
65: reads like an API, not a data file — e.g. `procfs (/proc/cpuinfo)`,
66: `sysfs (/sys/class/net)`, `registry (HKLM\\...\\BIOS)`. In `purpose`, name the **access
67: mechanism** (e.g. "经 `fs.readFileSync` 读取的内核伪文件接口"). The portable read call
68: (`fs.readFileSync`, `open`) belongs to its `standard` group; the platform-coupled
69: interface target (the path) belongs to the `system` group — these are two lenses on the
70: same call site and listing both is intentional, **not** a duplicate.
71: 
72: ## What to look for
73: - **Win32 / Windows**: `#include <windows.h>` and friends (`winsock2`, `wininet`,
74:   `shlobj`, `winreg`, `tlhelp32`, `psapi`); API calls (`CreateFileW`,
75:   `RegOpenKeyEx`, `VirtualAlloc`, `WaitForSingleObject`, …); from Python:
76:   `ctypes.windll`, `import win32api`/`pywin32`; `#ifdef _WIN32`/`_MSC_VER`.
77: - **POSIX / Unix**: `<unistd.h>`, `<pthread.h>`, `<sys/socket.h>`, `<sys/mman.h>`,
78:   `<fcntl.h>`, `<dlfcn.h>`, `<signal.h>`; calls like `fork`, `mmap`, `pthread_*`,
79:   `epoll`/`kqueue`, `dlopen`.
80: - **C/C++ standard library (STL)**: which `<...>` headers and `std::` facilities
81:   (containers, `<thread>`, `<atomic>`, `<filesystem>`, `<regex>`, `<chrono>`).
82: - **Managed-language standard library & system calls** (so a pure Python/Java/Node
83:   library is NOT reported as empty):
84:   - Python: `os`/`sys`/`socket`/`subprocess`/`threading`/`multiprocessing`/`mmap`/
85:     `select`/`signal`/`ctypes` — classify std ones as `standard`, OS-coupled ones
86:     (e.g. `os.fork`, `fcntl`, `termios`) as `system`.
87:   - Java: `java.io`/`java.net`/`java.nio`/`java.util.concurrent` (`standard`),
88:     `sun.misc.Unsafe`/`com.sun.*` (`platform`/`system`).
89:   - Node: `fs`/`net`/`dgram`/`http`/`stream`/`worker_threads` (`standard`),
90:     `child_process`/`process.binding` (`system`).
91: - **System / kernel level**: raw syscalls (`syscall(2)`, `prctl`, `clone`), `ioctl`,
92:   `/proc`·`/sys` reads, Windows registry (`RegOpenKeyEx`)/WMI/device handles.
93: - **FFI / interop bridges** — list only **real interop API calls**: Python C-API
94:   (`PyObject`, `Py_INCREF`, `PyBytes_*`, `boost::python` call sites), JNI functions
95:   (`JNIEnv`, `GetMethodID`, actual `JNIEXPORT` implementations), N-API (`napi_*`).
96:   Do NOT list **binding-generator directives / build tooling** — SWIG `%module`/`%include`,
97:   `EMSCRIPTEN_BINDINGS`, bare `extern "C"` declarations — those are bindings, already
98:   captured by dependencies (dim 6), `library.bindings`, and `dynamic_libraries`. If a
99:   library only has binding tooling and no direct C-API calls, omit the `ffi` group.
100: - **Graphics / device / accelerator APIs**: OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX/Direct3D,
101:   Metal, CUDA, OpenCL, audio/video device APIs.
102: - **Architecture-specific code (`arch_simd` group)**: x86/x64 SIMD intrinsics
103:   (`__popcnt`/`__popcnt64`, `<immintrin.h>`/SSE/AVX `_mm_*`), ARM NEON, CPU-id
104:   checks, and inline assembly (`asm`/`__asm`). Flag these as their own `arch_simd`
105:   group and note whether a generic fallback (e.g. `__builtin_popcountll`) exists —
106:   they indicate CPU-architecture coupling.
107: - **Dynamic loading (libraries loaded at runtime, NOT in package manifests)**:
108:   - C/C++: `dlopen`/`dlsym`/`dlclose`, `LoadLibrary(Ex)`/`GetProcAddress`/`FreeLibrary`.
109:   - Python: `ctypes.CDLL`/`WinDLL`/`OleDLL`/`cdll.LoadLibrary`, `ctypes.util.find_library`,
110:     `cffi.FFI().dlopen`.
111:   - Java: `System.loadLibrary(...)` / `System.load(...)`.
112:   - Node: native addons loaded at runtime — `require('*.node')`, `bindings`,
113:     `node-gyp-build`, `process.dlopen`.
114: 
115: ## How to analyze
116: 1. Use `grep`/search for the include/symbol families above to find candidate files.
117:    When codegraph is available (the agent will tell you), prefer it for structural
118:    lookups — `codegraph query <symbol> -p repos/<name> -j` to find definitions and
119:    `codegraph callers/callees -p repos/<name>` to confirm call sites — and fall back
120:    to grep/Read when it isn't.
121: 2. Open representative hits and confirm real usage (ignore comments, strings,
122:    third-party/vendored subtrees). **限定生产代码 —— 排除测试与示例/演示代码。** 用
123:    `metrics.json` 的 `code_metrics.top_dirs`/`test_example_dirs` 作基线，并对**按功能命名的
124:    demo 目录**（脚本 token 漏判的，如 `QLabel/`、`QThread/`、`QAxWidget/`——独立可运行示例）
125:    用判断补判为 example。**只在 test/example 里出现的 API 不是库的平台依赖，不要列入** ——
126:    每条 evidence 必须来自生产代码。若整仓是示例/教程集合，平台 API 据库本体收敛（通常近空）。
127: 3. Group findings by API family with concrete **evidence** (file + include/symbol).
128:    **List the concrete API symbols you actually saw — not just the family name.**
129: 4. For each dynamic-loading call site, **resolve the loaded library name** (read the
130:    string/variable passed to `dlopen`/`LoadLibrary`/`CDLL`/`loadLibrary`; if the name
131:    is computed at runtime, record `<dynamic>` and note what you can infer), and
132:    **infer its purpose in 简体中文** (e.g. `libssl.so` → "OpenSSL，提供 TLS/加密"). Note
133:    whether the load is `optional` (failure handled gracefully → an optional feature).
134:    Also infer, for the loaded lib, **`acquisition` (怎么获取)** and **`source` (是什么库/出处)** —
135:    crucially decide whether it is a **`self_build`** artifact built from THIS repo (a
136:    CFFI/JNI/SWIG wrapper like `librdkitcffi.so` / `GraphMolWrap`) or an external
137:    `system`/`third_party`/`bundled` library (like a proprietary `depict32.dll`).
138: 5. Judge **platform dependence**: are platform calls guarded by `#ifdef` (→
139:    cross-platform with backends) or unconditional (→ windows-only / posix-only)?
140: 
141: ## Output (fills report `native_api`)
142: ```json

145:   "groups": [

147:       {"name": "std::filesystem", "purpose": "跨平台路径与文件操作", "evidence": ["src/util/path.cpp:20"]},
148:       {"name": "std::thread", "purpose": "并发执行", "evidence": ["src/pool.cpp:14"]}
149:     ]},
150:     {"type": "win32", "category": "platform", "platform": "windows", "apis": [
151:       {"name": "CreateFileMapping", "purpose": "Windows 内存映射文件", "evidence": ["src/io/mmap_win.cpp:31"], "conditional": true}
152:     ]},
153:     {"type": "posix", "category": "platform", "platform": "posix", "apis": [

1: ---
2: name: dependency-analysis
3: description: Identify and explain a third-party library's or application's dependencies across ecosystems (Python, C/C++, Java, JS/TS) by reading manifest and build files, then reasoning about what each dependency is and why it's used. Distinguishes runtime vs dev/test/build deps. Use for dimension 6 of PC library/application analysis. Model reasoning over manifests, not a fixed parser.
4: ---
5: 
6: # Dependency analysis (model-driven)
7: 
8: Read the dependency manifests and build files, then produce a clean list with
9: scope and purpose. A rigid parser misses bundled headers, transitive build
10: deps, and ecosystem-specific quirks — reason about them.
11: 
12: ## 主旨与原则
13: 目标：把这个库的**第一层依赖关系**说清楚 —— 有哪些依赖、各自什么来源、怎么集成进来的。
14: **输出契约（下方 Output）是唯一硬约束。** 下面的 manifest 清单与 `acquisition` 取值是
15: **推荐起点，不是封闭清单**：`acquisition` 是**开放词表**，没有合适的就**自造一个简洁小写值**
16: （如 `conda`/`apt`/`cpm`/`git_subtree`/`runtime_download`）并写进 `meta.observations`；而
17: `locality`(本地/远端/系统) 是**稳定闭轴，必须显式给**，保证新造的 acquisition 仍能正确归类展示。
18: 方法仅是参考思路，可按仓库实际调整。
19: 
20: **粒度硬规则：一个可独立安装的包 = 一条依赖。** `name` 必须是**单一规范包名**（manifest/
21: registry 里的样子），**禁止**用 `/`、`,`、`+`、`、` 把多个不同的包拼进一个 `name`（下游的
22: 已鸿蒙化查询/仓库解析/依赖聚合/依赖树/导出都以 `name` 为单一包名）。
23: 
24: ## Manifests by ecosystem
25: - **Python**: `requirements*.txt`, `pyproject.toml` (`[project].dependencies`,
26:   `[project.optional-dependencies]`, poetry/PDM tables), `setup.py`
27:   (`install_requires`/`extras_require`), `setup.cfg`, `Pipfile`, `environment.yml`.
28: - **C/C++**: `CMakeLists.txt` / `*.cmake` (`find_package`, `target_link_libraries`,
29:   `FetchContent`, `ExternalProject`), `vcpkg.json`, `conanfile.txt`/`.py`,
30:   `Makefile` (`-l` link flags, `pkg-config`), git submodules (`.gitmodules`),
31:   vendored `third_party/`/`extern/` trees.
32: - **Java**: `pom.xml` (`<dependencies>`, distinguish `<scope>`), `build.gradle`(`.kts`)
33:   (`implementation`/`api`/`testImplementation`/`compileOnly`), `ivy.xml`.
34: - **JS/TS**: `package.json` (`dependencies` / `devDependencies` /
35:   `peerDependencies` / `optionalDependencies`), workspace/monorepo manifests.
36: - **应用（application）的依赖栈常不是单一 manifest**：要额外找——模块图（NetBeans
37:   `nbproject/project.xml` 的 `<module-dependencies>`/`<code-name-base>`）、构建期下载清单
38:   (`binaries-list`)、捆绑/随包分发的 jar/so/dll（`release/modules/ext/*.jar`、`lib/`、`external/`）、
39:   vendored 库、捆绑运行时(JRE/Node)。把应用**运行时实际捆绑/加载**的第三方库作为 `scope: runtime`
40:   依赖收录（locality 据来源：local 内嵌 / remote 下载 / system 预装），这样递归分析与依赖拓扑
41:   能照常下钻这些库。
42: 
43: ## How to analyze
44: 1. Find every manifest (record their paths in `manifests`).
45: 2. Extract **each** declared dependency with its **ecosystem**, **scope**
46:    (runtime / dev / test / optional / build / peer) and **version constraint**.
47:    **每行/每个声明一个包 = 一条**：requirements 里钉版本的 7 个 `pytest-*` 插件 = **7 条**，
48:    不要因为"都属测试/同族"就合并成一条；要表达归属就写在各自的 `purpose`（如"pytest 并发
49:    插件"），而不是把多个包名合进一个 `name`。
50:    `ecosystem` is the **language world only** (cpp/c/python/java/nodejs/rust/go/dotnet/other) —
51:    use `other` for non-language deps (data files, generic tools). Do NOT put role
52:    values like `tool`/`data` in `ecosystem`; a dep being a **build tool**
53:    (SWIG/Bison/Flex/codegen) is expressed by `scope: build` (its ecosystem is its
54:    implementation language or `other`).
55: 3. For notable runtime deps, add a short **purpose** ("HTTP transport",
56:    "JSON parsing", "test framework") inferred from name + how it's imported/used.
57: 4. Separate the project's **own** name and standard-library/system packages from
58:    real third-party deps. C/C++ `find_package(Threads)`, `PkgConfig`, the
59:    project itself, etc. are build plumbing — mark scope `build` or drop.
60:    **生产范围**：只被**测试或示例/演示代码** import 的依赖**不是 runtime** —— scope 记
61:    `test`/`dev`，或（仅示例用、与库本体无关时）不收。借 `metrics.json` 的
62:    `top_dirs`/`test_example_dirs` 判断目录归属，并补判按功能命名的 demo 目录。整仓为示例/
63:    教程集合时，runtime 依赖据库本体认定（通常只剩框架本身）。
64: 5. Note **vendored** dependencies (copied into the tree) and **git submodules**
65:    separately — they won't appear in a package manifest.
66: 5b. **C/C++ first-level completeness** — deps aren't only in `find_package`/`FetchContent`.
67:    Also capture: **pkg-config** (`pkg_check_modules`, `pkg-config --libs/--cflags`),
68:    **raw `-l` link flags** (Makefile, CMake `target_link_libraries(... -lfoo)` /
69:    `LINK_LIBRARIES` / `LDFLAGS`), and **third-party/system libs used only via
70:    `#include`** with no build-file declaration (e.g. `#include <zlib.h>` but no
71:    `find_package(ZLIB)`). These are usually `acquisition: system`; put the Makefile /
72:    source file in `declared_in` and note "链接标志 / 头文件包含" in `source`.
73: 6. For each dep set **`acquisition`** (OPEN vocab — HOW the build obtains it) and the
74:    **`locality`** stable axis (closed — set it explicitly). Recommended acquisition
75:    values & their usual locality:
76:    - `find_package(X)` / expected pre-installed → `system` · locality `system`
77:    - CMake `FetchContent_*` → `fetchcontent` · `remote`
78:    - `ExternalProject_Add` w/ URL or custom download-build (e.g. `downloadAndCheckMD5`)
79:      → `download_build` · `remote`
80:    - `.gitmodules` → `submodule` · `remote`
81:    - source copied into the tree (`External/`/`third_party/`/`extern/`) → `vendored` · `local`
82:    - vcpkg/conan/pip/npm/maven coordinate → `package_manager` · `remote`
83:    - binary `.so`/`.dll`/`.a`/`.lib` shipped in repo → `prebuilt_binary` · `local`
84:    If none fits, **coin a concise lowercase `acquisition`** (e.g. `conda`, `apt`, `cpm`),
85:    set the best-matching `locality`, and record the new value in `meta.observations`.
86: 7. Fill **`source`** — WHERE it is obtained from: the download URL, the registry,
87:    `"系统(find_package，需预装)"`, or the in-tree path (中文).
88: 8. Fill **`declared_in`** — the repo file(s) that declare how it is integrated:
89:    the CMakeLists with `find_package` / `FetchContent_Declare` / `ExternalProject_Add`
90:    / `target_link_libraries`, a `.gitmodules` entry, or a requirements/manifest line.
91:    This answers "仓库里有没有声明它是怎么集成进来的".
92: 9. Fill **`used_symbols`** (best-effort, 选填) — 本库**实际调用到**的该依赖的公共符号/API
93:    名（如 `cairo_create`、`BIO_new`、`numpy.ndarray`）。用 codegraph（`callees`/`search`）或
94:    grep 该依赖的头文件/导出符号在本仓的调用点取一组代表性符号即可，不必穷举。这是 dim-9
95:    **自底向上综合**用：服务端把它与该依赖（子库）`harmony_adaptation.unadaptable_apis[].public_entry`
96:    求交，命中才把子库的不可适配计为本库阻碍——**本库没调到子库的不可适配 API 就不阻塞本库迁移**。
97:    只对**非系统、可分析**的依赖填；系统库 / 拿不准用法时留空（综合会回退到依赖 scope）。
98:    - **命名约定（务必与子库 `public_entry` 同一形式，否则 rollup 求交漏判）**：填**调用方引用该符号时的名字**——
99:      Python `module.func` / `Class.method`；JS/TS 导出名（`pkg.export`/具名导出）；C/C++ 自由函数名或 `Class::method`；
100:      Java `Class.method` 或 `pkg.Class`。（服务端 `symKeys` 会再做大小写/尾段归一，但尽量对齐主名。）
101: 
102: ## Output (fills report `dependencies`)
103: ```json
104: {
105:   "count": 5,
106:   "manifests": ["pyproject.toml", "requirements-dev.txt"],
107:   "by_ecosystem": {"python": ["urllib3", "certifi"]},
108:   "dependencies": [
109:     {"name": "Qt6", "ecosystem": "cpp", "scope": "optional", "version": null,
110:      "purpose": "MolDraw2D Qt 后端", "acquisition": "system", "locality": "system",
111:      "source": "系统(find_package，需预装 Qt6)", "declared_in": ["Code/GraphMol/MolDraw2D/Qt/CMakeLists.txt"]},
112:     {"name": "coordgen", "ecosystem": "cpp", "scope": "optional", "version": "3.0.2",
113:      "purpose": "2D coordinate generation", "acquisition": "download_build", "locality": "remote",
114:      "source": "https://github.com/schrodinger/coordgenlibs（未找到时 downloadAndCheckMD5 下载源码内嵌编译）",
115:      "declared_in": ["External/CoordGen/CMakeLists.txt"], "used_symbols": ["sketcherMinimize", "CoordgenMinimizer"]},
116:     {"name": "AvalonTools", "ecosystem": "cpp", "scope": "optional", "version": "2.0.5-pre.3",
117:      "purpose": "额外指纹与结构检查", "acquisition": "vendored", "locality": "local",
118:      "source": "仓库内 External/AvalonTools", "declared_in": ["External/AvalonTools/CMakeLists.txt"]}
119:   ],
120:   "notes": "Also vendors 'chardet' under src/; pytest is dev-only."
121: }
122: ```
123: 
124: ## Rules
125: - **一包一条，`name` 不拼接**：
126:   - ❌ 错：`{"name": "pytest / pytest-asyncio / pytest-cov / pytest-repeat / pytest-rerunfailures / pytest-timeout / pytest-xdist"}`（7 个独立包拼成一条）。
127:   - ✅ 对：拆成 `pytest`、`pytest-asyncio`、`pytest-cov`… 各一条，各带自己的 `version`。
128:   - **例外**：`name` 里出现 `/` 仅在它表示**同一个依赖的可选版本/形态**时允许，**不是**多个不同包——
129:     如 `Qt5/Qt6`（二选一的同一可选依赖）、`Java JDK / JNI`（JDK 经 JNI 访问，仍是一个东西）。
130:     判据：**各自有独立版本号 / 各自在 registry 单独存在 ⇒ 必须拆**；仅是"同一依赖的别名/可选实现" ⇒ 可合并为一条。
131: - Prefer runtime deps in the headline `count`; keep dev/test/build but scoped.
132: - `dependencies[].harmony_adapted` / `harmony_adapted_source` are **script-stamped**
133:   (`scripts/harmony_adapted.js`, an OpenHarmony-PC-mirror lookup) — leave them to the
134:   script, do NOT set them from guesses.
135: - Don't list transitive deps unless lockfiles are the only source and the user
136:   needs them — say so in `notes` if you do.
137: 
138: ## 自我发现（反哺）
139: 新造的 `acquisition` 值、推荐清单没覆盖的依赖场景、难归类的歧义，追加到顶层 `meta.observations`：
140: `{dimension:"dependencies", field:"acquisition", kind, value, rationale}`，供面板「模型观察」页人工反哺。
